_comment: Transcribed from an in-game screenshot taken 2026-08-01 (Steam capture index 108 in the 16:03 run). Gadget screens carry a name, a model designation and a description but no stat block or trait chips, so this item has no stats or ratings. Art is cropped from the same shot. The page leads with the model designation because that is what EA's patch notes use. Unlock and Requirement transcribed from the in-game challenge text (source: Battlefield 6), recorded 2026-08-01.
name: Vehicle Supply Crate

description.text: A pallet that resupplies ammunition for nearby friendly vehicles.

_alias_note: EA calls it the "Engineers Supply Crate". Distinct from the Support class's Supply Bag, which is a different item.
